item.title: Trump as a symptom, weaponized Christianity & Freedom Flotilla with Tadhg Hickey
item.description: Olga and Tara welcome Irish satirist and activist Tadhg Hickey for a raw assessment of the current geopolitical landscape. In this episode, we examine what Donald Trump as president actually signals for the international rules-based order. We also look into the “weaponization of Christianity.” How is religious rhetoric used to justify imperial interests today? Tadhg shares what really happened when Israel disrupted the Freedom Flotilla’s effort in 2024 and how the activists were treated. We explore the resilience of nations like Iran under decades of sanctions. From the collapse of traditional “diplomatic decorum” to the rise of a post-truth political era, we analyze the systemic tremors reshaping our world.

item.title: V-Day episode: Why the West hides their most important WWII ally – with Caleb Maupin
item.description: Olga and Tara sit down with journalist and political analyst Caleb Maupin – to peel back the layers of the “official” narrative surrounding the Second World War, and its modern-day consequences. Why is the history of the 20th century being rewritten in real-time, and who benefits from the confusion? We discuss the Soviet Union's role in defeating fascism, diving deep into the uncomfortable truths the West often ignores. How are these historical distortions used to fuel today’s conflicts in Ukraine and beyond? From the rise of the “New Left” to the influence of the CIA on modern social movements, Caleb Maupin and the hosts break down how the “deep state” uses historical amnesia as a tool for geopolitical control. С Днем Победы! On Victory Day, we remember

item.title: Iran’s uranium for data centers and ‘soft mutiny’ in US Navy with Stanislav Krapivnik
item.description: Olga and Tara welcome former US Army officer and geopolitical analyst Stanislav Krapivnik to discuss new dimensions of the unrelenting conflict in the Persian Gulf. As the US faces an AI-driven energy crisis and a lack of domestic enrichment capacity, is the uranium “heist” in Iran a matter of national survival? Was the mission to save a US pilot a cover-up to attack a uranium site? We also analyze the “soft mutiny” within the US Navy, the internal factions vying for control of Washington’s foreign policy, and why the current military-industrial complex is structurally incapable of winning a long-term war.

item.title: Techno fascism, AI taking over Pentagon, and Ukraine as testing ground – with Viktor Bout
item.description: Olga and Tara welcome Viktor Bout, whose career inspired the Hollywood film ‘Lord of War’. After serving over a decade in a US prison and returning to Russia in a high-profile prisoner exchange, Viktor has entered the political arena. He breaks down the ‘Silicon Coup’ and why he believes AI-driven warfare is the greatest threat to humanity. We discuss techno fascism, Palantir, Ukraine, NATO, and the future of global power. We pinpoint the ethical red line of allowing AI to make life-and-death decisions on the battlefield – and how Ukraine has become a testing ground for experimental software. From the ‘PayPal Mafia’ to the fight for digital sovereignty, we break down why the next war won’t just be fought with boots on the ground, but with algorithms and predictive policing. We also discuss Victory Day, Germany’s historical memory, the Ukraine conflict, Christianity and ideology, Africa’s shifting alliances, and the emerging struggle between national sovereignty and global techno-political power.

item.title: Real reasons why US-Iran talks stalled — insider’s account with Prof. Mohammad Marandi
item.description: Olga and Tara are joined by Professor Seyed Mohammad Marandi, who was on the ground in Islamabad during the high-stakes 21-hour negotiations between the US and Iran. We analyze the breakdown of diplomacy between US Vice President J.D. Vance and the Iranian delegation. Is the US strategy a calculated move for regional dominance, or a sign of diminishing diplomatic options? We look into the reality of the Strait of Hormuz crisis and the ‘information war’ that is shifting global perceptions of power. We also explore how civilian casualties get normalized in global coverage and why Western media turn a blind eye to assassination calls for Iranian negotiators.

item.title: UFO disclosures, missing scientists & breakaway civilization — with Reuben Langdon
item.description: Olga and Tara welcome film producer and host of the Extra Dimensional show Reuben Langdon to untangle the secret webs of black budgets, hidden technology, and the actual forces that may be driving the current wave of UFO congressional hearings in the US. We dive deep into the recent release of UAP files and ask the critical question: why have top scientists connected to alternative energy and anti-gravity research been disappearing since the Roswell crash? Is the government using a “slow-release” disclosure strategy to prevent mass panic, or is the military-industrial complex protecting the ultimate global asset – reverse-engineered technology? What happens if the technologies hidden behind these programs could change energy, warfare, and global power forever? We also look at how modern warfare has shifted away from traditional country-versus-country conflicts into a sophisticated system of psychological operations, media control, and energy dependency designed to maintain the status quo.

item.title: Israel as the ‘51st state’ and the cult of armageddon with George Galloway
item.description: Olga and Tara welcome former British Parliamentarian and veteran broadcaster George Galloway to break down the explosive shifts in Middle East geopolitics — and much more. We examine the “culture of impunity” and the unique status of Israel as what Galloway calls America’s “51st state.” Is the world witnessing a dangerous slide toward a “Second Vietnam” in Iran? We also dive into the “eschatological mania” driving current US defense policy and Galloway’s own recent legal battles, and his “exile in the East” following his arrest under UK terrorism laws.
